messages:
Alex C.: quick async standup — what I did: merged tiny routing fix (PR #487), added a fallback route for model-preview traffic. noticed a small spike in 429s on canary at 11:40m — looks correlated with bursty /v1/generate traffic.
Maria G.: thanks — do you have the logs link? can you paste the sample 429 trace?
Alex C.: logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/teams/eng/2126/trace/5f1e — snippet below:
```
429 response from gw-01: 'rate_limit_exceeded' header: X-RateLimit-Remaining=0, bucket=shortburst
request path: /v1/generate, route: model-preview
client: svc-frontend-32
```
Samir: pinging rate-limits side — we pushed a token-bucket tweak yesterday, possible the burst window is too small. i'll roll a small increase for the shortburst bucket in staging.
Tayla: for context, shortburst is 200r/s with refill 1000ms, might need to bump to 400r/s during the canary window. also suggest enabling delayed-token mode for the preview route.
Benji: @Samir FYI there's a rollback PR ready if we need to revert quickly: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/gateway/PR-492. It reverts the token-bucket change.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: rollout/gw/rate-tweak -> staging at 12:15 UTC by Samir. CI: ✅, smoke: pending.
Alex C.: blockers: i can't reproduce locally because local traffic is too smooth. needing someone to trigger a short canary load + trace the kv for that bucket.
Maria G.: i can run a canary from my laptop around 12:20 UTC. what's the load profile you want?
Alex C.: ~250 qps for 2 mins with bursts up to 600 qps for 10s. use `wrk` with this script:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d120s --script=burst.lua https://gw-canary.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Samir: started the staging roll now. will monitor X-RateLimit-* metrics and token-bucket drops.
Tayla: quick question on auth rotation — do we need JWT rotation to be part of the canary? I remember a twiddle in auth middleware last week.
Benji: good catch — the middleware change is in PR #489. it's been merged to canary-only flag. it shouldn't affect token validation, but it does alter header passthrough. keeping an eye.
Alex C.: ask: if canary shows <1% 429s we keep tweak; if >2% revert immediately. can someone call the rollback PR if threshold hit?
Maria G.: on it. i will monitor and DM channel if >1%.
Samir: staging metrics look better after bumping refill. 429 rate dropped to 0.4% in first 5m. pushing to canary in prod in 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout in prod: gw/rate-tweak -> canary started at 12:33 UTC. health: initializing.
Tayla: heads up for code review: i left comments on PR #487 about a small lint and a missing unit test for route selection. no blockers for merge.
Alex C.: noted, i'll add the test this afternoon.
Benji: logistics: next standup sync moved to tomorrow 09:30am PT. same agenda: routing policies, auth, rate limits.
Alex C.: ok thanks team :thumbsup: will follow up with results and the test PR later today.
